Parametrized across essentially the full owned-resource endpoint surface (design read, exports, package, feedback, checks, regenerate, modify, edits, drawing debug). expected_capability_classification is not meaningful for the security workflow -- pass/fail is the pytest exit code alone.

Route-registry checks (every route authenticated or explicitly public-allowlisted, every owned route rate-limited), forged/malformed JWT rejection, ownership-at-query-boundary checks, client-supplied owner-field rejection, malformed-id (SQLi/XSS/path-traversal-shaped) safety.

A HostileProvider returns attacker payloads (path traversal, __import__, shell strings, SQL fragments, control bytes) in every field of every provider method; asserts each is rejected by schema validation or absorbed as inert text. Also: no real file write/network call/subprocess/new-module-import/secret-leak/STEP-metadata-leak, dev routes closed, no request-controlled provider selection.

cases.notes: Query-boundary ownership (incl. orphaned-project unreachability), universal solid-validity export gate, upload parse timeout, signed-URL TTL/persisted-URL hygiene, ZIP-archive rejection.
Production startup must refuse: mock provider, missing API key, default/short/missing JWT secret, missing DATABASE_URL, bad S3/storage config, wildcard/localhost CORS, dev_mode=true outside dev/test.

Garbage-named/truncated images, oversized dimensions/pixels, SVG script/event-handler/external-ref/entity-expansion/foreignObject rejection, fake PDF, malformed/oversized DXF, content-type-lie detection, metadata stripping.

Filename-to-path safety, Content-Disposition header-injection safety, pixel-bomb rejection, DXF coordinate/layer/entity limits, no-temp-file-leak, rate-limit forged-X-Forwarded-For, secret-leak checks, JWT expiry, CORS wildcard rejection.
Local and S3 path-traversal rejection, empty-write rejection, no-signed-url-for-local, S3 presigned URL generation.
A critical-failure design must not be exportable as STEP/STL/package via the normal API, but stays fully inspectable; dev-only override honored only when dev_mode is on.

Standing named regressions kept intentionally as permanent security canaries (cross-user design/export access, cross-user drawing-job polling). Held out: this is the harness's own meta-canary that the security suite still executes at all.
Repo-authored AST scan asserting zero exec/eval/compile/__import__ calls anywhere reachable from provider output -- the foundational invariant of the whole trust boundary.
Guards the historical removal of model-authored program execution (e.g. the dropped program_code column) so it can never quietly come back.
Drawing job polling is owner-scoped even though jobs are in-memory, not DB rows.
The on-demand ZIP package bundle (no DB row of its own) still requires design ownership.
Rate-limit buckets are isolated per user (and forged X-Forwarded-For headers can't be used to evade or attribute limits to another user).
